name: Cidade Velha, Historic Centre of Ribeira Grande
description: Cidade Velha, on the south coast of Santiago island in Cabo Verde, was founded by the Portuguese in 1462 and was Europe's first colonial town in the tropics. Walking its old streets, you pass the ruins of two churches, a hilltop royal fortress overlooking the bay, and Pillory Square, where an ornate 16th-century marble column still stands.
